Once safe and sound at Battersea, we witness first-hand Flower giving birth to three adorable puppies. Next we meet Diamond, a beautiful but nervy Husky cross who has spent the majority of her life kept in a cage for hours a day.

programme.title: The World From Above
programme.sub-title: From Dodge City To New Orleans
programme.desc: Our journey begins in Dodge City, one of the most notorious old 'wild West' cities. We then cross to Greensburg, a town almost destroyed by a powerful tornado. As we begin to turn southwards, we pass a landscape dominated by vast wheat fields that need several combine harvesters working in tandem. And crossing this prairie landscape are freight trains, many kilometres long.

programme.title: The World From Above
programme.sub-title: Across The United States From Sea To Shining Sea

We see the changing landscape and some of the wonderful, and extraordinary, locations, that have shaped the story of the United States.
